en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a lively bathing scene at a lake. Many people in early 20th‑century swimwear are swimming and wading in the water, while two people are in a small rowing boat in the foreground. A long wooden pier on stilts stretches across the mid‑ground with figures standing and walking on it. Trees and low shoreline are visible in the distance. The caption at the bottom right reads "Wermsdorf - Bad Horstsee."
